skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand basic issues of financial law, distinguish between public and private financial laws, understand sources of financial law, and grasp fundamental legal provisions of financial law.
Understand key provisions of budgetary law and basic contents of tax law.
Ability to search for information and legal regulations.
Ability to analyze, synthesize information and resolve legal situations.
Ability to communicate, present and deliver presentations.
Ability to independently research, accumulate knowledge and experience to enhance professional expertise.
